name: Repeat incident pattern review
summary: A safety lead with a year of incident records and earlier actions gets them compared in groups: confirmed causes, what was done before, and where incidents recur, with questions for the team. A competent person judges what the pattern means.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of reviewing a year of incident records for patterns, and its own rules for prepared work: stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, groups built only from recorded fields, small groups shown with less detail, every gap written as a question, and nothing changed, sent or decided until a person decides.
